articles.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
articles.description: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.

articles.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
articles.description: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.

articles.title: AI company Anthropic announces IPO, expected as early as November
articles.description: The artificial intelligence company disclosed more than $16 billion in revenue and an $80 billion net loss for the first half of 2026.

articles.title: NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
articles.description: The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.

articles.title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
articles.description: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.

articles.title: Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
articles.description: The agreement adds S&P Dow Jones gauges to a growing list of Wall Street firms expanding their involvement in prediction markets.

articles.title: PHP flaw shows AI ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ is on schedule: Immunefi CEO
articles.description: Mitchell Amador warned internet users that websites could remain compromised for weeks, particularly smaller websites slower to adopt the emergency upgrades.

articles.title: Strategy skips Bitcoin purchases, spends $205M on STRC buybacks
articles.description: Strategy made no Bitcoin purchases or sales last week, as its STRC preferred stock buybacks reduced its USD Cash balance by 46% to $242.4 million.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: HOOD’s prediction markets to add $1.7B to revenue, exceed crypto by 2028: Bernstein
articles.description: Bernstein analysts raised Robinhood’s revenue estimates through 2026 and 2028, while maintaining their HOOD price target unchanged at $160.

articles.title: Aviva Investors launches tokenized share class of $29B Sterling fund on XRP Ledger
articles.description: The move marks Aviva’s second fund to list tokenized shares, part of a broader collaboration to bring more tokenized funds to the XRP Ledger.

articles.title: BTC price risks $80K loss into FOMC, earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Bitcoin bulls fought for $80,000 support over the weekend ahead of a heavy week of US tech earnings and inflation data.

articles.title: Securitize’s tokenized stock value halves as Circle widens lead
articles.description: SECZ’s onchain market cap fell to $208.6 million as Circle-linked tokens reached a combined $383.6 million across several issuers in the $3.3 billion tokenized equities market.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs break 2-week outflow streak with $301M comeback
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with $301 million in net inflows after a strong three-day start gave way to heavy withdrawals.

articles.title: Musk warns over 200 AI neoclouds face ‘guppy-level death’
articles.description: The warning comes as Gartner forecasts that more than 80% of specialist cloud providers will cease operating independently by 2030.

articles.title: Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed firm said it plans to establish Solana validator operations in Hong Kong.

articles.title: Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses
articles.description: A security researcher warned that the leaked shipping details could expose crypto holders to targeted scams and physical attacks.

articles.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin
articles.description: The Standard Chartered and Animoca Brands joint venture previously targeted retail access as early as the end of 2026, but its CEO declined to reaffirm that timeline.

articles.title: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: Similar to the Hugging Face hack, Ethereum researchers have set up an AI Agent message board to help rescue the Glamsterdam fork. ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site successfully hacked.

articles.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
articles.description: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

articles.title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
articles.description: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.

articles.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
articles.description: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

articles.title: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
articles.description: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.

articles.title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
articles.description: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

articles.title: US senator probes Tether after reported deal with ex-Trump crypto adviser
articles.description: The Democratic ranking member of the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations asked Paolo Ardoino for records related to a reported deal between Tether and Nxum.

articles.title: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations
articles.description: The SEC’s latest priorities highlight tokenization as an emerging market risk, while cryptocurrencies remain absent as a standalone examination category.

articles.title: Bitcoin seeks support above $81K as Brent crude oil hits highest level since March
articles.description: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 as stocks fell and Brent crude hit its highest level since March, leaving the 50-day moving average in focus.

articles.title: China targets 2030 for its national blockchain network buildout
articles.description: China’s five-year digital development plan calls for wider blockchain use in trade and manufacturing alongside stronger technical standards.

articles.title: New York AG seeks $1.37B from NovaTech founders over Ponzi scheme
articles.description: The request follows an August 2025 default judgment, with the AG also announcing nearly $6 million in settlements with four promoters.

articles.title: Bitcoin consolidates after 3% loss as AI fears stoke fresh stock-market weakness
articles.description: Bitcoin price volatility cooled as stock markets battled another day of resurgent AI fears during Friday’s Asia trading session.
